structured_data_template.abstract: Morpurgo’s volume-normalized weighted Yamabe heat trace comparison, stated for every dimension at least three, is false in dimension three. We specify one smooth positive conformal weight on the round three-sphere whose scaled heat trace exceeds 13/20 at a specified positive time, whereas the round maximum is less than 321/500. The argument applies classical cylindrical conformal geometry and Dirichlet min–max estimates. A finite cylinder length, explicit smooth caps, and exact rational certificates give quantitative separation.
